gen.title: From general rate law to flight distance ideas
gen.orderNote: Follows the page development from general law to flight cases and limits

steps.label: rate times time equals amount
steps.quote: The general rate equation is “rate times time equals amount”.
steps.orderHint: starts with the general statement of rate

steps.label: distance (d)
steps.quote: The amount is the distance (d) the airplane has flown, the rate is the aircraft’s ground speed (V), and the time (t) is the time aloft.
steps.orderHint: identifies what amount, rate and time mean for flight

steps.label: ground speed times the time aloft
steps.quote: the distance flown is equal to the ground speed times the time aloft.
steps.orderHint: applies the law to distance flown

steps.label: d = V * t
steps.orderHint: shows the symbolic form of the relation

steps.label: maximum time (tmax)
steps.quote: The maximum distance that the aircraft can fly is then equal to the ground speed times the maximum time (tmax).
steps.orderHint: extends the idea to the fuel limited case

steps.label: maximum range (R)
steps.quote: We call this distance the maximum range (R) of the aircraft.

steps.label: R = V * tmax
steps.orderHint: gives the symbolic form for the limit

steps.label: combat radius
steps.quote: The combat radius would be half of the range as specified here.
steps.orderHint: distinguishes one way and round trip usage
